summary: Mobile critical bug verification for MoodFood app. Code review confirms critical fixes are implemented. UI testing was partially blocked by authentication flow issues (login modal closes but doesn't redirect to chat). Previous iteration (65) verified the fixes work correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Critical bugs from user report appear to be FIXED based on code review and previous iteration testing. New issue discovered: Login modal closes after successful API call but doesn't redirect to chat page. To test the Live Cooking Mode: 1) Set auth token directly in localStorage, 2) Navigate to /chat, 3) Select mood → meal → diet → cuisine, 4) Wait for AI, 5) Click 'View Full Recipe', 6) Wait for details to load, 7) Click 'Start Step-by-Step Cooking Mode'. Previous iteration 65 verified this flow works.
